name: 涂鸦会话列表
description: 手绘涂鸦风格的会话列表：把完整模式的「切换会话」列表与「待审批」列表合并成同一套涂鸦卡片风格，统一排版（会话卡片含行内重命名/删除，审批卡片含类型标签、理由展开、反馈与批准/拒绝）。
description-en: Hand-drawn doodle session list that merges the session switcher and the pending-approval list into one unified doodle card style: session cards support inline rename/delete, approval cards carry a type tag, an expandable reason, feedback and approve/reject actions.
